    @pytest.mark.priority(11)
    @allure.title("validate the dashboard's Upcoming Appointments widget shows the correct date/time across all available timezones")
    def test_case_11(self):
        # Driving the Profile page's timezone dropdown through the UI proved
        # flaky (the combobox intermittently hangs mid-interaction), so set
        # the timezone via the same API the Profile page itself calls, and
        # only use the UI to validate the resulting date/time rendering.
        token = hub_coach_login(self.hub_email, self.hub_password)
        original_timezone_id = get_hub_profile(token)["timezone"]
    
        try:
            for timezone_name, timezone_id in TIMEZONE_ID_BY_DISPLAY_NAME.items():
                update_hub_profile_timezone(token, timezone_id)
                # The app caches profile/timezone client-side; a reload forces
                # it to pick up the change made out-of-band via the API.
                self.page.reload()
    
                self.scheduler.go_to_scheduler()
                self.scheduler.switch_to_list_view()
                self.scheduler.set_list_page_size("50")
                datetime_cell = SchedulerPage.list_row_datetime_cell(self.__class__.event_name)
                self.scheduler.wait_for_visible(datetime_cell)
                # e.g. "Jul 30, 2026 · 2:00 PM EDT" -> date "Jul 30", time "2:00 PM"
                list_date_time_text = self.page.locator(datetime_cell).inner_text()
                list_date_part, list_time_part = [part.strip() for part in list_date_time_text.split("·")]
                expected_date = list_date_part.split(",")[0].strip()
                expected_time = " ".join(list_time_part.split()[:2])
    
                self.scheduler.go_to_dashboard()
                row_locator = SchedulerPage.appointment_row(self.__class__.event_name)
                self.scheduler.wait_for_visible(row_locator)
                detail_text = self.page.locator(SchedulerPage.appointment_detail_line(self.__class__.event_name)).inner_text()
                lines = [line.strip() for line in detail_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and line.strip() != "·"]
                actual_date, actual_time = lines[0], lines[1]
    
                assert actual_date == expected_date, \
                    f"[{timezone_name}] expected date {expected_date!r}, got {actual_date!r}"
>               assert actual_time == expected_time, \
                    f"[{timezone_name}] expected time {expected_time!r}, got {actual_time!r}"
